risks.title: Decreased Leasing Demand for Communications Infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: A significant reduction in leasing demand would materially and adversely affect business and operating results. Risk is driven by wireless/cloud provider capex decisions, communications service provider consolidation, economic conditions, and technological changes including AI and RAN sharing.

risks.title: Customer Disputes and Litigation
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing disputes with major customers (AT&T Mexico representing ~$300M annual revenue, DISH representing ~2% of total property revenue) present material financial and operational risks, with potential negative impact on results and reputation.

risks.title: Customer Concentration Risk
risks.score_rationale: Heavy dependence on wireless carriers and communications service providers creates concentration risk. Loss of major customer would have material negative impact on revenues and business continuity.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: Growing competition in communications infrastructure could pressure lease rates, margins, and customer retention, particularly from alternative infrastructure providers and network sharing arrangements.

risks.title: Technological Disruption
risks.score_rationale: Emerging technologies including AI, satellite communications, RAN sharing, and wireless equipment changes could reduce demand for traditional tower infrastructure and accelerate infrastructure obsolescence.

risks.title: Divestiture Activities and Portfolio Transitions
risks.score_rationale: Recent divestitures (South Africa Fiber in 2025, ATC TIPL in 2024) create transition execution risk and potential asset value realization challenges, though currently limited impact.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risks
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes affecting zoning, environmental rules, spectrum licensing, taxation, and REIT compliance requirements could increase operating costs and limit business expansion.

ai_positioning.summary: American Tower Corporation acknowledges artificial intelligence and technological changes as emerging risk factors that could affect customer demand for communications infrastructure and network deployment strategies. AI is mentioned in the context of technological disruption risks, including potential changes in wireless equipment, RAN sharing adoption, and network deployment patterns.
evidence: Factors affecting leasing demand include 'technological changes, including artificial intelligence (AI), wireless equipment changes, satellite technology and an increase in the use of radio access network (RAN) sharing among wireless service providers'
